title: Applicable law.
bodyText:
(a) Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, the law applicable to arbitration is chapter 658A.

(b) In determining the merits of a family law dispute, an arbitrator shall apply the law of this State, including its choice of law rules.
bodyHtml:
[§658J-4]  Applicable law.  (a)  Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, the law applicable to arbitration is chapter 658A.

     (b)  In determining the merits of a family law dispute, an arbitrator shall apply the law of this State, including its choice of law rules. [L 2017, c 113, pt of §1]
